summary_1line: Victor seeks solace in the Alps but encounters his creature on a glacier, leading to a fierce confrontation and the creature demanding to tell his story.

image_candidates.scene_text: On the vast glacier beneath Mont Blanc, the gigantic figure of the creature bounds across the ice toward Victor with superhuman speed.
Victor stands on a rocky recess overlooking the glittering sea of ice as sunlight breaks through the clouds around Mont Blanc.
Inside a cold mountain hut, Victor sits by a small fire while the towering, grotesque creature begins to tell his story.
